(ns sdk-set-world-diagnostic
 (:require [compile.sdk :as sdk] [compile.world :as world] [expand :as expand]))
(let [directory (Path/join (System/tmp_dir!) (str "set-world-probe-" (erlang/unique_integer (list :positive))))
      selection {:sdk 'clojure.set :revision 'selected :only ['union]}
      provider (:source (sdk/capture selection))
      source (str "(ns set.client) (import-world 'clojure.set 'selected :only [union]) "
                  "(begin-for-syntax (import-world 'clojure.set 'selected :only [union])) "
                  "(defsyntax answer [form ctx] (syntax-literal (union #{1 2} #{2 3}))) "
                  "[(union #{1 2} #{2 3}) (answer)]")]
 (File/mkdir! directory)
 (try
  (File/write! (Path/join directory "main.bl") source)
  (File/write! (Path/join directory "phase.bin") (expand/encode-phase-library (expand/phase-library [provider])))
  (doseq [[label libraries] [["archive-first" ["phase.bin"]] ["selected-sdk-second" [selection]]]]
   (try
    (File/write! (Path/join directory "world.bl")
     (str "'" (pr-str {:version 1 :profile 'syntax-v1 :entry ['set.client 'current]
                       :sources [{:namespace 'set.client :revision 'current :file "main.bl"}]
                       :libraries libraries})))
    (let [prepared (world/prepare (Path/join directory "world.bl"))]
     (println :prepared label :sdk-inputs (:sdk-inputs prepared))
     (println :result label (world/execute prepared [])))
    (catch-raw [kind reason frames] (println :failed label kind reason frames))))
  (finally (File/rm_rf! directory))))
